_comment: Action set for character sprite generation via Wan2.2 image-to-video. Each action is generated independently from the SAME reference image, so identity/outfit is inherited from the image, not re-described here — keep prompts focused on the motion. Running the pipeline with no --actions flag generates every entry below.
shared_negative_prompt: blurry, distorted, extra limbs, changing outfit, morphing face, inconsistent appearance, low quality, static image, camera shake, zoom, motion blur, text, watermark
